text:
aaron_cust: Hey team — we're ready to start a POC with Redwood. Need a billing project/org for the POC, spend cap set to $2,000, and ephemeral API keys for ~5 devs. Also planning a Private/VPC setup in week 2. Can you provision Hosted keys now and queue the VPC work? Thanks.

maria_sales: Thanks, Aaron. Can you confirm the company domain and primary contact? Also, do you want us to start with Hosted keys and reserve Dedicated capacity, or skip Dedicated until later? :slightly_smiling_face: 

aaron_cust: Domain is acme.co, primary contact aaron@acme.co. Start with Hosted keys for devs, please reserve a Dedicated pool in the background so we can test it next week (no need to warm it yet).

sam_se: I can take the provisioning. Quick clarifying q: do you want per-team quotas or a single pooled quota for the POC? And rough token/day targets so we set sensible limits.

aaron_cust: Per-team please. Initial estimates: eng team 100k tokens/day, data-science 50k tokens/day. Spend cap $2k total. Also: are there trial credits you can apply?

jess_finance: We usually apply $1k in trial credits for POCs from central promo budget. @maria_sales can you confirm approval to add the extra $1k?

maria_sales: Approved to apply $1k promo credit. I'll note it on the opp. We'll set a hard spend cap for the org at $2k and apply the $1k trial as credit (so effective allowance is $3k but billing blocked above $2k per the spend cap — we'll explain the invoicing flow).

sam_se: Provisioning plan (high-level): I'll create a billing project 'acme-poc', set quota profiles for the two teams, enable ephemeral key issuance, and set the spend cap. Example CLI I will run (for ops team):

```
rictl billing create-project --name "acme-poc" --owner aaron@acme.co --notes "ACME POC - Sales promo applied"
rictl credits apply --project acme-poc --amount 1000 --type trial
rictl quotas set --project acme-poc --quota "eng:100000" --quota "data:50000" --spendcap 2000
rictl keys create --project acme-poc --type ephemeral --count 5 --ttl 7d --scopes generate,embeddings
```

sam_se: I'll also add a locked quota profile so alerts trigger before the spend cap and ops can top-up if needed.

dev-provisioner-bot: Billing project created: acme-poc (project_id: acme-poc-1795). Trial credit $1000 applied. Spend cap set to $2000. Ephemeral keys queued for delivery.

sara_security: For the Private/VPC work in week 2: you'll need to complete the security questionnaire, provide an allowlist of IP ranges, and confirm whether you'll require customer-managed KMS. I uploaded the SQA template here: https://redwood.internal/sqa/acme-template (internal). Please have your infra/security team review.

aaron_cust: Got it — we'll return the questionnaire by EOD Friday. For the ephemeral keys, can you deliver them to Slack handles for the dev team (e.g., @dev_alice, @dev_bob) rather than email? Easier for onboarding.

maria_sales: We can DM the keys to Slack handles once provisioning completes. @jess_finance please ensure billing contact is set for invoicing.

jess_finance: Invoice contact set to finance@acme.co. I'll monitor spend notifications and escalate if the spendcap threshold is hit.

sam_se: Note on Dedicated pool: request queued for capacity estimate 1x A100-equivalent to start. If Dedicated isn't ready by your canary day we'll fallback to Hosted with reserved throughput and explicit routing policy so your tests are deterministic.

dev-provisioner-bot: Ephemeral keys delivered via DM to @aaron_cust and @dev_bob. Example header for testing:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer rk_dev_ephemeral_XXXXX" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
aaron_cust: Keys received, running smoke tests now. Latency looks fine. One request: can we restrict some dev keys to the /generate endpoint only (no admin scopes)?

sam_se: Yup — scope-limited keys are supported. We'll re-issue two keys with `--scopes generate` only.

maria_sales: Closing the loop from sales side: I've updated the opportunity with project id acme-poc-1795, trial credit applied, and spend cap. If you hit quota or spendcap alerts ping me and we'll escalate to finance for temporary top-ups. :thumbsup:

aaron_cust: Awesome, thanks everyone — this is great. We'll start tests and come back with results/requirements for the VPC phase.

sara_security: I'll follow up with the SQA checklist and a preliminary network diagram we need.

maria_sales: Thanks all. Leaving the Dedicated request in ops queue and tagging @sam_se for follow-up next week.
